title: Unique Domains for Node: the SDK and the command line of the Unique Domains API
description:
The Unique Domains API answers questions about domain names: whether a name is taken, what its registry record says, what registrars charge for each ending, and what the domain market did. It covers names, words, endings (TLDs), registrar prices, the market, naming trends and the industry agenda.

This repository holds its Node packages. @uniquedomains/sdk is a typed client for every endpoint, with methods grouped by what they read. @uniquedomains/cli runs every endpoint as a command, with nothing to install: npx @uniquedomains/cli get-name get.plumbing. Four smaller packages each answer one question, from code or as a command.

Without a key, the API answers 62 of its 87 operations, 20 rows a page, within 60 calls an hour and 100 a day from one address. The other 25 operations need a key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
